disposition_reason: Narrative review of 20 years of literature on arsenic, mercury, cadmium and lead exposure in people on gluten-free diets and in rice-based foods; it reports no new food measurements.

study.design: narrative literature review (Medline and Scielo, English, French and Spanish, last 20 years)

regulatory_or_exposure.what: US FDA action level cited for inorganic arsenic in infant rice cereal

unresolved: All food values in the review are quoted from other studies (for example its reference 14 on gluten-free foods); none are recorded as findings.
